City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 8, 2014 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 12/10/13 Special Meeting, 12/10/13 Special Meeting and the 12/11/13 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-01-08 Item #8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-01-08 Item #8B Warrants List
8C.
Consider adoption of City Council Resolution No. 2014-02 establishing a no stopping, standing or parking zone on the west side of Orpheus Avenue. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Blough
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-02 establishing a no stopping, standing or parking zone on the west side of Orpheus Avenue.
2014-01-08 Item #8C Resolution 2014-02 No Parking on Orheus Avenue
8D.
Membership in San Diego Regional Climate Collaborative. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
Approve submittal of application by the City of Encinitas for membership in the San Diego Regional Climate Collaborative
2014-01-08 Item #8D Membership in San Diego Regional Climate Collaborative
8E.
Adoption of Resolution 2014-03 authorizing a CalRecycle City/County payment program application. Contact Person: Management Analyst Wilson
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-03 authorizing a CalRecycle City/County payment program application
2014-01-08 Item #8E Resolution 2014-03 CalRecycle Payment Program
8F.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2013-10, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.40 - Traffic Commission and Chapter 14.08 Sections 14.08.070 - Traffic Commission and 14.08.080 - Duties of the Traffic Commission. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Ordinance No. 2013-10, entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.40 - Traffic Commission and Chapter 14.08 Sections 14.08.070 - Traffic Commission and 14.08.080 - Duties of the Traffic Commission."
2014-01-08 Item #8F Ordinance 2013-10 Traffic Commission
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Consideration of a two-councilmember subcommittee to provide direction and input on the proposed permit application for the Interstate-5 Widening Project and affirmation of Staff's determination that a separate City initiated Local Coastal Program Amendment should not be pursued. Contact Person: Associate Planner Strong
That a subcommittee be created that will be chaired by two Councilmembers, who will meet on an ad-hoc basis. Staff also recommends that the City not develop a separate amendment to its Local Coastal Program (LCP) for the proposed Interstate-5 Widening Project for the reasons specified in this staff report.
2014-01-08 Item #10A Consideration of Council Subcommittee for I-5 Widening Permit
10B.
Environment Focus Area Strategic Plan Planning Session Topics. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
Review and approve topics for Environment Focus Area Planning Session
2014-01-08 Item #10B Environmental Focus Area
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS There are no Informational Items.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM There are no Council Member Initiated Items.
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2014-01-08 Item #15 City Manager Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
